title: Renames the `next_source_action` field for Payment Intents to `next_action`
summary: Renames the next_source_action property on the PaymentIntent to next_action.
migrationNotes: Update your code to reference next_action instead of next_source_action when handling additional actions required for payment processing. This modification provides more generalized terminology that could accommodate various types of required actions.

Renames the `next_source_action` property on the PaymentIntent to `next_action`.
